serverInfo.name: net.gulfaro/gcc-jobs-mcp
serverInfo.title: Gulfaro GCC Jobs MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for searching and inspecting active public GCC job vacancies across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman on Gulfaro.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.title: Search Gulfaro GCC Jobs
tools.description: Search active, unexpired job vacancies across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman by keyword, country, city, category, or employment type. Read-only and returns only public job listings.

query.description: Optional keyword to match job title, company, skills, city, or description (max 120 characters).

city.description: Optional city filter (e.g. Riyadh, Jeddah, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha).

category.description: Optional job category slug or name (e.g. engineering, healthcare-medical, accounting-finance).

limit.description: Maximum number of active jobs to return (1-25, default 10).

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.title: Get Gulfaro Job Details
tools.description: Retrieve full public details for a single active, unexpired Gulfaro job vacancy using its Job ID (e.g. GF-901) or URL slug. Read-only.

jobIdOrSlug.description: Public Gulfaro Job ID (e.g. GF-901) or URL slug.

tools.name: browse_jobs_by_country
tools.title: Browse Gulfaro Jobs by GCC Country
tools.description: Browse active, unexpired job listings and regional market metadata for one GCC country: saudi-arabia, uae, qatar, kuwait, bahrain, or oman. Read-only.

country.description: Required GCC country slug: saudi-arabia, uae, qatar, kuwait, bahrain, or oman.

city.description: Optional city filter within the selected country.

category.description: Optional job category slug within the selected country.

limit.description: Maximum number of active jobs to return (1-25, default 10).
